title: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants

result.label: Nagata’s conjecture and maximal Seshadri constants
result.statement: Proves Nagata's strict inequality mi d r for every nonzero effective plane curve of degree d through r ≥ 10 very general complex points, with arbitrary multiplicities m i . It also proves maximal multipoint Seshadri constants (L^n/r)^ 1/n for every smooth polarized projective variety of dimension n ≥ 2 and all sufficiently large r : at very general points over ℂ, and at the geometric generic tuple over any algebraically closed field of positive characteristic.
